comparison.objective: Safely isolate a pneumatic manifold, disconnect its push-to-connect tube and insert a blanking plug; candidate removes defective open cartons while preserving contents.
comparison.physical_skill: Valve/padlock/dump manipulation, collet depression with coordinated tube withdrawal, and precision plug insertion/retention versus moving-target sidewall grasping and level tray transfer.
comparison.success_condition: Latest versions require padlock and pressure below 0.1 bar before release, tube removal, plug seating/gripping and a 15 N retention check; candidate instead grades carton-specific spill history, belt clearance, tray dwell and no-contact passage.
comparison.reason: The objectives and central mechanisms—pressure-isolated fitting service versus carton classification and transport—are materially different despite generic insertion and handling primitives. Numeric criteria are present across all supplied spec versions.
